target: Restore bounded semantic-maintenance throughput and cross-device cloud closure without changing raw history, summary text, device trust, or federation wire protocol.
invariants: Raw messages and completed summary Markdown remain immutable authorities.
A real artifact drift remains fail-closed and produces a quarantine receipt.
Federation event sequences remain contiguous; no failed artifact is silently skipped.
One failed summary, peer, or cloud stream does not block unrelated eligible work.
Replay projections contain only compact summary records and never duplicate raw dialogue or summary Markdown content.
Successful ACK, import, and publish stages remain durable when a later stage fails.
Malformed rollout quarantine remains visible as coverage debt and never rewrites or deletes source history.
Interrupted installation recovery preserves every displaced Skill tree before restoring the prior generation.
The packaged macOS dashboard is the canonical universal application and every failed transaction tree remains recoverable.
allowed_changes: Preserve Level-1 round-number metadata during deterministic index reconstruction.
Share one immutable source snapshot across a bounded semantic batch and finalize derived updates once.
Add compact content-addressed summary-record replay projections and quarantine receipts.
Add cross-stream failure isolation and per-stage cloud progress persistence.
Add bounded maintenance progress and timing telemetry.
Persist content-free malformed-source fingerprints and retry only after the source bytes change.
Recover a post-switch-mutated active Skill tree without overwriting a non-empty destination.
Rebuild the packaged macOS dashboard through the canonical universal pipeline and make repeated rollback evidence idempotent.
Reproduce ledger-bound summary timestamps and bounded historical empty-default shapes only when the complete candidate payload exactly matches the immutable ledger SHA-256.
prohibited_changes: Rewrite raw dialogue, existing summary Markdown, device identities, peer trust, keys, or pairing state.
Skip a federation event, accept a changed artifact as immutable, or partially import a corrupt inbound bundle.
Duplicate raw dialogue or summary Markdown into export replay storage.
Change federation protocol version, bundle format, summary format, or trigger thresholds.
Install or publish a candidate that has not passed the frozen release rehearsal.

original_triggers: A rebuilt summary registry dropped sparse source-round metadata and changed an immutable federation artifact hash.
One failed summary or cloud stream blocked unrelated eligible work at the same layer.
A semantic batch repeatedly scanned the complete archive and rebuilt derived indexes after each job.
Unchanged malformed rollout files were reparsed every event cycle and prevented the installation effect watermark from committing.
Interrupted macOS recovery attempted to replace a non-empty Skill directory when the active candidate generation had changed after cutover.
A temporary single-architecture dashboard binary silently exited self-check and a repeated rollback collided with existing failed-candidate evidence.

A summary Markdown write and its index append crossed a one-second boundary, while rebuilt parent indexes normalized historical null or absent round defaults to zero and empty arrays; the legacy replay path could not reproduce either shape.

failure_escalation.first_failure: Stop the failing stage, preserve evidence, and repair only the canonical owner named by the bounded reproducer.
failure_escalation.after_limit: Do not install or publish; return the remaining blocker for a new user decision.
